newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-ALKER HANGS ON TO WIN QUEENSLAND OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ALKER HANGS ON TO WIN QUEENSLAND OPEN.

text.p: New Zealand's Steve Alker held off Australian Greg Chalmers over the final round of the Queensland Open on Sunday to win his first Australasian PGA Tour title by one stroke.

Alker, who took the lead from Chalmers after Saturday's third round, fired a composed even-par round of 72 to finish with a 13-under-par aggregate of 275 at the Windaroo Country Club course outside Brisbane.
Chalmers had led comfortably after two rounds but could only shoot par on the last two days to finish on 276.
Australian Shane Tait, who equalled the course record 64 on Saturday, dropped to a 73 to share sixth with New Zealand's Michael Long on eight-under 280.
